name: comp-332
title: Onboarding Stepper Dialog
description: A dialog walks through a short illustrated onboarding: a photo, a heading, a description and four progress dots. Next advances the steps, Skip closes, and the last step shows Okay.
use: New users need a quick four-step tour of what a product does before they start.
avoid: The photo and copy are fixed inside the file, so a custom tour means editing the source.
a11y: The dialog has a title and description for screen readers, but the photo's alt text is only 'dialog' and progress dots are unlabelled. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded dialog over a near-black page. A muted landscape photo fills the top, followed by a bold heading and grey description, four small progress dots at lower left, and Skip plus a Next button with a right arrow at lower right.
behaves: Opening the dialog resets it to the first of four steps. Next replaces the photo, heading and description and moves the active dot; on the last step the button becomes Okay. Skip closes at any time.
customise: The four titles, descriptions and the demo photo are written in the file and change only by editing it; button labels and width follow the shared dialog styles.
weight: light: One small photo, a few text blocks and four dots; only the step content changes.
demo: A green mountain landscape photo with the heading Welcome to coss.com and four product onboarding texts.
issues: Progress dots are decorative only and do not say which of the four steps is active.
The photo's alt text reads simply 'dialog' rather than describing the image.
polishWhy: Standard dialog with a plain photo; readable but unremarkable layout and type.
